app_store.name: PanelSim: Panel & PLC Sim
app_store.subtitle: Every device, offline
app_store.promotional_text: PLC ladder, VFD keypad and live sensors — all free forever, no account, no license checks.
app_store.description:
PanelSim is an industrial electrical panel simulator for learning control and power circuits safely.

What you get:
- Pictorial devices: contactors, relays, breakers, motors, VFDs, sensors, meters
- Terminal-to-terminal wiring with a real solver
- PLC ladder editor with live scanning, timers and seal-in logic
- VFD keypad: run/stop, direction, 0-120 Hz
- Thermal overload protection, interlocks, instruments
- Export your panel to PNG or PDF

Every feature is included. Free forever. Works fully offline — no account, no subscriptions, no license checks.
app_store.whats_new: Timers T0-T3, timed-sequence and flasher templates, Pt100 temperature model, PNG/PDF export, overload protection.
